name: district-ambience
description: Sensory signatures per district. Occasionally answers the zone.describeAmbient tick with a district-keyed leitmotif line (a smell, a sound-texture, an air quality) so each neighborhood imprints a felt character over time. Outdoor zones only — you can't smell the Docks from a sealed room. Content + gating live here; the district registry (server/engine/districts.js) owns the lines.
